component.name: Genesis
component.summary: Deterministic procedural wallpapers, live and still

description.p: Genesis is a procedural wallpaper engine where every image is described by a small JSON recipe. The same recipe always produces byte-identical pixels, so a wallpaper is a diff you can read, share, and revert — not a blob.

Render curated stills, keep the ones you love starred, get a fresh wallpaper every morning from the daily timer, or animate a composition behind your windows with the cursor-reactive live mode (X11). Everything runs locally; there are no accounts and no network calls.
First tagged snapshot: deterministic stills, library, daily timer, and live mode.
